name: YouTube Channel Insights
description: Reads your own YouTube channel through the YouTube Data API v3: channel stats, video lists, single-video details, and aggregate channel analysis.

commands.title: Get channel info
commands.description: Returns the channel's title, description, URL, subscriber count (null if hidden), total video count, and total view count.

commands.title: List channel videos
commands.description: Returns recent videos with title, publish date, URL, duration, views, likes, comments, and engagement rate. Input: { maxResults?: 1-200, default 20; sortBy?: "date" | "views", default "date" }. With sortBy "views", only the most recent maxResults videos are ranked.

commands.title: Get video details
commands.description: Returns full details for one video: stats, description, tags, category, and definition. Input: a YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID.

commands.title: Analyze channel
commands.description: Returns channel info plus aggregate statistics over the most recent videos: average and median views, average engagement rate, average duration, Shorts count, upload frequency, and top videos by views. Input: { sampleSize?: 1-200, default 50 }.

config.label: YouTube Data API v3 key
config.description: Your Google API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled. Stored by Mocu and sent only to the YouTube API.

config.label: Your channel ID or handle
config.description: Your channel ID (starts with UC) or handle (for example @yourname).
